# Change Heidrun Code settings
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Use Settings to adjust voice input, notifications, text detection, safety guards, and information cards.

## Open Settings

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/layout.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/SettingsModal.vue -->

Open the **More** menu and choose **Settings**. Choose a section in the Settings window to find the options described below.

## Configure voice input and voice words

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/settings_voice_input.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/settings_voice_words.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary/voice_input.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/settings/SettingsVoiceInputSection.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/settings/SettingsVoiceWordsEditor.vue -->

In **Voice input**, set the available voice options and edit the word replacement list to replace recurring recognition errors. Use the voice input control in a pane's composition bar to dictate into that pane.

## Adjust text detection and guards

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/settings_text_detection.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/terminal_text_detection.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/terminal_text_detection_other_families.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/terminal_text_detection_references.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/settings_guards.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/settings/SettingsTextDetectionSection.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/settings/SettingsGuardsSection.vue -->

Use **Text detection** to change which terminal text Heidrun Code recognizes and offers actions for. Use **Guards** to review built-in and project safeguards and their actions.

## Adjust notifications and information cards

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/settings_notifications.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/settings_information_cards.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/settings/SettingsNotificationsSection.vue -->

Choose the relevant Settings section and change an option. A reset returns an option to its implemented default; it does not necessarily restore your previous custom value.
